- **Credit Report / Application**: Letter of explanation for recent credit inquiries remains pending. Borrower must provide written explanation addressing the inquiries noted on the credit report.

- **Employment Verification**: Verbal verification of employment (VVOE) with Crestmarin Insurance Services is required within 10 business days of closing per policy. Underwriting must complete and document VVOE no later than November 18, 2026.
